stage: Prospective confirmation; freeze before any new target outcome

candidate.method: Continuous behavior posterior, historical likelihood-fitted risk discrepancy, stable Bernoulli probability ranking
candidate.prior: Uniform normalized brake/gap/delay and balanced IDM/FVDM; equal prior particle masses
candidate.history_scope: 65536 response labels from sixteen profiles train the conditional predictor; 32768 labels and known configurations from eight additional historical profiles validate it and calibrate risk model error
candidate.collision_model: Conditional Bernoulli NN given latent behavior; independent of risk discrepancy under the working model
candidate.selection: Maximize posterior collision probability through stable log noncollision probability; no budget-dependent risk mixing
candidate.discrete_control: Same fitted model error and sixteen actual historical behavioral hypotheses
candidate.fixed_control: Same continuous prior and NN, fixed ranking without target-risk updates
candidate.matched_control: Same conditional response NN at sixteen historical states, same risk/collision calibration; previous best GP kernel with collision-score-only acquisition

statistical_unit: SUT profile, averaging two pools and five predictor seeds
zero_failure_pool: Area=0, recall=1, zero paired differences; retained
testing: Eight exact two-sided paired sign-flip tests with Holm correction, bounded-memory half-sum search
test_assumption: Exchangeable signs of paired profile differences under their nulls
confidence_interval: Paired bootstrap within controller kind, 20000 draws
success_rule: Positive means and Holm p below round_alpha for both metrics against all four primary controls; both bootstrap 95% lower limits positive against previous_best and matched_collision_gp
multiple_rounds: Spend 0.05/2**r; future failed rounds become development and use new profiles and coordinates
selection_feedback: Queried continuous risk only; RAS receives queried collision only
target_parameters: No actual target parameters or full response arrays enter selector payloads
scope: New IDM/FVDM parameter profiles within declared ranges, same highway-env simulator and two finite scenario families
